reviews.review: Been playing a ton of this game with my girlfriend!  We really like it and it's a fun multiplayer experience.  There are still some pretty glaring bugs and weak spots in the game such as some of the mountains and their texture mapping and structure.  Some parts of the game feel kind of dead and lifeless.  Multiplayer can lag a bit at times, but overall the game is very fun and enjoyable.  I understand it's in early access so I have complete faith the issues with it will be fixed soon.

Game is a great concept, I know I know we've all seen this before. BUT Issues I keep running into have rectified a uninstall. Consistent crashing, spending hours grinding to log in the next day and its all gone, falling through the map and getting stuck underneath. They're dropping valentines day events while all of this actively occurs. Every once good game died because the attention and efforts put forth are in the wrong place. Hopefully their heads didn't get too big off one month of success to see this game needs a lot of work. Ill check back in a few months.

Just in love with this game. I have not had this much fun since Valheim released years ago. The game is smooth, works great, very optimized, low number of bugs, updates have been consistent to fix issues, and more. The pal designs are great (although I wish there was evolution types). The survival aspect and technology tree is immense, but needs more building pieces for sure. Tower bosses and world boss alphas are great. The game def need some more endgame bosses or raids to test our OP pals. Throw in some quests for rewards and that should turn up the fun and replay-ability. I would also love to see humans use pals to attack. The only one who does this right now is the pal merchant; i need more battles like that outside of towers. I'm sure more will come as some of this has already been announced on their road map. 

I will support this game in any way I can. I cannot wait for the future of this game. The potential is endless!
